concepts.title: Activation Procedure
concepts.description: Outlines the step-by-step procedure, CLI commands, prerequisites, and rollout guidelines for activating Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band on a node.

concepts.title: Deactivation Procedure
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure and traffic impact for deactivating the Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band feature.

concepts.title: FEATURE DEPEDENCIES
concepts.description: Feature, hardware, and network dependencies as well as operational limitations for Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band.

concepts.title: FEATURE OPERATION
concepts.description: Details the operational mechanism of Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band, including per-carrier closed-loop state maintenance, TPC command generation, and blockage recovery.

concepts.title: Feature Overview
concepts.description: Overview of Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band for NR FR2/mmWave carriers operating as PCells or SCells.

concepts.title: Network Impact
concepts.description: Details the network impact of Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band on interference, throughput, UE battery, signaling, and KPIs.

concepts.title: Parameters
concepts.description: Defines the sector carrier-level parameters and configuration defaults for closed-loop high-band power control.

concepts.title: Performance Management
concepts.description: Performance management guidance, KPIs, and counters for monitoring Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band convergence, stability, and interference reduction.
